config.pad_handling: convolution-window-aware: for each kernel size, a window is only eligible for max-over-time pooling if every position it covers is non-PAD; windows touching any PAD position are masked to -inf so PAD can never create an artificial n-gram feature. If a sample has zero eligible windows for a given kernel size (e.g. all-PAD, or fewer real tokens than the kernel size), that kernel's pooled feature is set to a finite zero vector instead of -inf
